criteria.name: Star-schema design & fit-for-purpose
criteria.description: Star schema built from flat files with the grain declared; relationships have deliberate cardinality and cross-filter direction; role-playing dimensions handled; a dedicated Date table, not Auto date/time.

criteria.name: DAX foundations
criteria.description: Ten core measures correct; measures (not calculated columns) used for aggregations; command of filter vs row context and context transition evident in the code.

criteria.name: Storage-mode reasoning
criteria.description: Import vs DirectQuery vs Composite chosen from workload (size, freshness, source load) — the decision memo ends with an explicit, defended decision line, not a survey.

criteria.name: Documentation & clarity
criteria.description: Model doc and measure list read like a BI developer wrote them — concise, labeled, reproducible.

criteria.name: Design quality & UX
criteria.description: Clean layouts, correct chart types, no anti-patterns; conditional formatting and color carry meaning; interactivity serves the user, not the developer.

criteria.name: Anti-pattern diagnosis
criteria.description: The critique names ≥10 concrete anti-patterns with why-it-misleads and a specific fix — before/after, not a checklist.

criteria.name: Chart selection reasoning
criteria.description: Each visual is chosen for the decision the page supports; part-to-whole, trend, comparison and distribution handled with the right encodings.

criteria.name: Interactivity & polish
criteria.description: Custom theme, bookmarks and drill-through wired correctly; pages navigate cleanly and progressively disclose detail.

criteria.name: Time intelligence
criteria.description: YTD/QTD/MTD, YoY and rolling measures correct over a custom fiscal calendar, written without copying templates.

criteria.name: KPI & analytics thinking
criteria.description: KPIs have meaningful targets and RAG thresholds; variance is explained in business terms, not just numbers; KPIs drive an action.

criteria.name: Advanced patterns
criteria.description: What-if slicers, RANKX, dynamic measure selection and/or calculation groups applied correctly and documented in the pattern library with gotchas.

criteria.name: Row-level security
criteria.description: Dynamic RLS configured with USERPRINCIPALNAME(), tested with View as Role, and the security-performance trade-off acknowledged.

criteria.name: Enterprise BI operations
criteria.description: Deployment plan sizes workspace/app topology, RLS matrix, refresh strategy per dataset, and gateway HA for 500 users; cross-platform note is credible.

criteria.name: Performance optimization
criteria.description: Three real optimizations with before/after timings and an SE-vs-FE diagnosis — not generic advice.

criteria.name: Capstone build under pressure
criteria.description: New-domain dashboard is correct, published, and coherent; model, KPIs and pages hold together; scope decisions were sound.

criteria.name: Live defense (hostile Q&A + stakeholder scenario)
criteria.description: Explains filter context under pressure; defends design with UX reasoning; handles pushback without ego; stakeholder scenario answered with concrete moves.

criteria.name: Communication & storytelling
criteria.description: Leads with the insight; flexes register from VP pitch to engineer deep-dive; the context deck and pitch stay on time and on point.
